clue.text: Footballer for Rovers Charlie avoids an outer garment for pub?

parts.note: Roy Race, hero of the British comic strip Roy of the Rovers

Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.walkthrough: 'avoids' takes C from CLOAK, leaving LOAK. Roy of the Rovers was a long-running British football comic.
explanation.definitionFit: The Royal Oak is one of the commonest names for a British public house, so it stands as an example of a pub.
